name: Primary and Secondary Dev Runtime Profiles
description: Make primary and secondary first-class local runtime profiles with isolated ports, DuckDB files, and judgment-job SQLite state.

userStories.title: Add the primary and secondary runtime profile source of truth
userStories.description: As a developer, I want centralized runtime profile definitions so all launch commands derive the same ports and isolated data roots for primary and secondary.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/utils/runtimeProfile.ts` with `primary` and `secondary` profile definitions.
Each profile defines `VITE_PORT`, `API_SERVER_PORT`, `BACKGROUND_WRITER_PORT`, `APP_SERVER_PORT`, and `DUCKDB_PATH` under `data/runtime/<profile>/forska.duckdb`.
Profile helpers expose merged env values for launchers while leaving runtime code env-driven.
Add focused tests for runtime profile mapping and env merging.
`bun test src/utils/runtimeProfile.test.ts` passes

userStories.title: Add profile-aware migration runner and scripts
userStories.description: As a developer, I want migrations to run through the selected runtime profile so primary and secondary always migrate separate DuckDB and SQLite roots.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `scripts/runWithRuntimeProfile.ts` support for a DuckDB migration mode.
`db:mig` runs the primary profile and `db:mig:secondary` runs the secondary profile through the shared runner.
Primary and secondary migration runs resolve to different `DUCKDB_PATH` parents so `judgment-jobs` state also stays isolated.
`bun test src/utils/runtimeProfile.test.ts` passes
`bun run db:mig` passes
`bun run db:mig:secondary` passes

userStories.title: Add profile-aware stacked and split server launcher modes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the shared runner to launch stacked, API-only, and worker-only server modes so both profiles can run side by side without manual env export.
acceptanceCriteria: `scripts/runWithRuntimeProfile.ts` supports stacked server, API-only server, and worker-only server modes.
API-only server mode sets `SERVER_ROLE=api` and the matching profile `SERVER_WRITER_URL`.
Worker-only server mode sets `SERVER_ROLE=worker` with the matching profile ports and isolated data root.
`bun test src/utils/runtimeProfile.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/utils/backgroundServerStack.test.ts` passes

userStories.title: Rewire primary and secondary server scripts to the shared runner
userStories.description: As a developer, I want committed primary and secondary server scripts so I can start stacked or split server roles for either profile with stable commands.
acceptanceCriteria: `package.json` rewires `dev:server`, `dev:server:api`, and `dev:server:worker` to the primary profile runner modes.
`package.json` adds `dev:secondary:server`, `dev:secondary:server:api`, and `dev:secondary:server:worker` using the secondary profile runner modes.
The server commands for each profile resolve to separate DuckDB files and separate `judgment-jobs` directories under `data/runtime/primary/` and `data/runtime/secondary/`.
`bun test src/server/utils/backgroundServerStack.test.ts` passes

userStories.title: Add profile-aware app dev commands
userStories.description: As a developer, I want primary and secondary app dev commands so each Vite instance opens on the correct port and proxies to its matching API profile.
acceptanceCriteria: `scripts/runWithRuntimeProfile.ts` supports an app dev mode.
`dev:app` launches the primary app dev profile and `dev:secondary:app` launches the secondary app dev profile.
The secondary app dev command proxies `/api` requests to the secondary API instead of the primary API.
`bun test src/utils/runtimeProfile.test.ts` passes
Verify in browser primary and secondary dev profiles run together with separate ports, separate DuckDB files, and separate `judgment-jobs` dirs

userStories.title: Add profile-aware built app start commands
userStories.description: As a developer, I want primary and secondary built app commands so each built app server talks to the matching API/server profile without manual env setup.
acceptanceCriteria: `scripts/runWithRuntimeProfile.ts` supports the built app server mode used by `src/appServer.ts`.
`start` launches the primary built app profile and `start:secondary` launches the secondary built app profile.
The primary and secondary built app commands use the correct `APP_SERVER_PORT`, API target, and isolated data root for their profile.
`bun run build` passes
Verify in browser built `start` and `start:secondary` point at the correct API/profile

userStories.title: Document the primary and secondary local run workflow
userStories.description: As a teammate, I want the local run docs to explain primary and secondary commands so I can start isolated profiles without remembering manual env wiring.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `README.md` and `docs/README_RUN_LOCAL.md` with the implicit primary commands and explicit secondary commands.
Document that DuckDB and judgment-job SQLite isolation comes from separate profile roots under `data/runtime/primary/` and `data/runtime/secondary/`.
Document stacked server commands, split API/worker commands, and built app commands for both profiles.
`bun run build` passes
